sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Abuse is not always obvious. Many parents only recognise it after learning the signs.

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: Abuse can be emotional, financial, sexual, physical, or digital. It often escalates gradually.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.content: Parents learn to identify patterns such as gaslighting, intimidation, and financial restriction.

sections.title: Activity
sections.content: List behaviours that made you feel unsafe or controlled. Compare them to the categories of abuse.

sections.title: Reflection
sections.content: Recognising abuse is a powerful step toward safety and healing.
